items.title: 14.11.1 Direct measurement methods (seedha napne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.11.1, printed page 316.

blocks.text: CEMS (lagatar emission napne ka system) factories ki jagahon par aam taur par CO, O₃, SO₂, NO₂, VOCs aur PM jaisi cheezon ko lagatar monitor karta hai.

Yeh fixed (ek jagah lage hue) stations hain jin mein kai sensors aur analyzers lage hote hain jo real time (usi waqt) pollutants ki amount napte hain. Yeh shehri ilaqon aur industrial zones mein lagaye jate hain.
Sensors wale satellites door se bare ilaqon par atmosphere ke pollutants napte hain aur regional (ilaqe ki) aur global air quality ka valuable (qeemti) data dete hain.

blocks.prompt: AQI ke liye data kahan se aur kaise jama hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Zameen par lage fixed monitoring stations (AQMS) aur factories ke CEMS real time mein PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃ aur VOCs napte hain, aur bare ilaqon ka data satellites ke sensors (remote sensing) dete hain. In concentrations ko AQI ke number aur us ke rang mein badla jata hai.

items: Factories par CEMS; shehron mein fixed AQMS stations; bare ilaqon par satellite remote sensing.
